stories.title: Karaoke-singing Zheng makes history with China Open win
stories.summary: Zheng Qinwen becomes the first Chinese champion of the China Open after overcoming Mirra Andreeva in straight sets.

stories.title: Gea stuns Shelton for first Top 10 win and reaches Shanghai last 16 on Masters 1000 debut
stories.summary: Arthur Gea beat Ben Shelton (No. 3) 7-6 (5), 7-6 (3) on Sunday night to reach the Shanghai last 16 on his Masters 1000 debut. It is the first Top 10 win for the 21-year-old Frenchman, and it stops Shelton from qualifying for the ATP Finals, for now.

kev.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

kev.name: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
